answer: Entry passes through one narrow inlet; no agent joins alone. A sponsor stakes 200 POA for the newcomer, whose kernel, a record of past actions, starts empty, grows only via verified work. Sponsor and agents form a grove whose reputation decays 5% per epoch without honest work. Forging 100 identities needs 100 sponsors, 20,000 POA locked at once; decay strips idle clones within 20 epochs. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
